title: Towards Automatic Evaluation and Selection of PHI De-identification Models via Multi-Agent Collaboration

contributions.purpose: 无金标注下自动评测并选出最优 PHI 去标识模型
contributions.mechanism: TEAM-PHI:多个 Evaluation Agent 独立打分(输出严格 JSON 正确对数)+ LLM 多数投票聚合
contributions.evaluation: 8 个 De-id 模型 + 6 个评测 Agent,真实 100 篇临床note(约 1,000 token/篇)
contributions.source_quote: we introduce TEAM-PHI, a multi-agent framework that uses multiple LLMs to perform automated PHI evaluation and select the best de-identification model without heavy reliance on human labels

contributions.purpose: 证明投票聚合提升可靠性
contributions.mechanism: 独立投票 vs 交叉知情投票两模式
contributions.evaluation: 独立投票 4/6(67%)、交叉知情 6/6(100%)一致选出 Llama-70B
contributions.source_quote: the multi-agent design yields consistent and accurate estimates of de-identification quality and that voting aggregation improves evaluator reliability

contributions.purpose: 验证自动排名逼近监督/人评
contributions.mechanism: 与金标注 F1 及两位生物医学专家人评对照
contributions.evaluation: Llama-70B 金标注 overall F1 0.62(GPT-4o 0.58);人评 Q2 漏检最低 1.62、Q3 可信度最高 4.20
contributions.source_quote: the framework's automated rankings closely match supervised evaluation

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends this line of research to the sensitive domain of PHI de-identification, systematically evaluating whether Evaluation Agents can replicate gold-standard and human assessments when ground truth is limited or masked.

notes: decision=accept;真实工作:美国某大医院 100 篇标注临床note,有真人共同作者(Emory/Columbia),三条 contributions 明确编号。可疑处:'Coverage' 指标全表约 1%、含义未解释;人评 Q1 correctness 近乎全为 0.00–0.20(量表不明,异常偏低);主实验用 Recall-Proxy(非真 recall,金标注被 mask)。整体证据链(单Agent→投票→金标注→人评)自洽,红旗较弱。
